run: set -eux; extensions_dir=/opt/atelier/vscode-extensions; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gpg; install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings; curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg; echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends code; code --version --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/code-version; install -d -o atelier -g atelier /home/atelier/.vscode-server "$extensions_dir"; chown -R atelier:atelier "$extensions_dir"; code_commit="$(code --version --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/code-version | sed -n '2p')"; case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in amd64) server_arch=x64 ;; arm64) server_arch=arm64 ;; *) echo 'Unsupported VS Code server architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; server_dir="/home/atelier/.vscode/cli/serve-web/Stable-$code_commit/server"; mkdir -p "$server_dir"; curl -fsSL "https://update.code.visualstudio.com/commit:$code_commit/server-linux-$server_arch-web/stable" -o /tmp/vscode-server.tar.gz; tar -xzf /tmp/vscode-server.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C "$server_dir"; chown -R atelier:atelier /home/atelier/.vscode; su atelier -c "'$server_dir/bin/code-server' --version"; chmod -R a+rX /home/atelier/.vscode /home/atelier/.vscode-server "$extensions_dir"; find "$extensions_dir" -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +; find "$extensions_dir" -type f -exec sh -c 'for file do magic="$(head -c 4 "$file" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d " ")"; first2="$(head -c 2 "$file")"; if [ "$magic" = "7f454c46" ] || [ "$first2" = "#!" ]; then chmod 0755 "$file"; fi; done' sh {} +; apt-get purge -y code gpg; apt-get autoremove -y; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.microsoft.gpg /tmp/code-version /tmp/vscode-server.tar.gz
